chunks: His people came hurrying to him. And previously they had been doing the evil deeds. He said: 'O my people, here are my daughters, they are purer for you. Have fear of God, and do not shame me in my guests. Is there not among you a man of discernment?'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot offer his people to keep them from sin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Lot's (عليه السلام) strategic offer of his daughters to provide a lawful marital alternative to the specific act of sodomy his people desired, serving as a diplomatic plea to preserve his guests' honor. The rhetorical question 'أ لَيْسَ مِنْکُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ' underscores the moral decay of the community, contrasting their lack of a 'rashid' (discerning/guiding) man with the presence of a prophet, thereby emphasizing the loss of innate moral reasoning.
